name: dom-benchmark
description: To-do app in React, Angular, Vue and Svelte with an identical DOM benchmark harness

scripts.install:all: cd react-todo && npm install && cd ../angular-todo && npm install && cd ../vue-todo && npm install && cd ../svelte-todo && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run sync && cd react-todo && npm run build && cd ../angular-todo && npx ng build && cd ../vue-todo && npm run build && cd ../svelte-todo && npm run build
scripts.bench: python3 bench/run_benchmarks.py -n 25 --traces && python3 bench/run_benchmarks.py -n 25 --warm 5 && python3 bench/run_benchmarks.py -n 10 --cpu 4
